description: This file contains functions for exporting notes in various formats (PDF, Markdown, HTML, Text) within the Notesnook project. It includes functions for exporting individual notes and multiple notes, handling streams, creating ZIP archives, and interacting with the DOM for printing PDFs.

methods.name: exportToPDF
methods.description: Exports note content as a PDF by creating an iframe, setting its content, and invoking the print dialog.

methods.name: exportNotes
methods.description: Exports multiple notes in specified formats, creating ZIP archives and handling errors.

methods.name: exportNote
methods.description: Exports a single note in specified format, handling attachments and PDF export.
